name: embedded-device-logger
description: Stream and filter embedded Linux device logs over SSH inside VS Code.
author: A. Scillato

embeddedLogger.defaultPort.description: Default SSH port applied to devices that do not specify one.

embeddedLogger.defaultLogCommand.description: Default log command used when a device omits logCommand.

embeddedLogger.defaultEnableSshTerminal.description: Whether devices without an explicit enableSshTerminal flag should show the SSH terminal action.

embeddedLogger.defaultEnableSftpExplorer.description: Whether devices without an explicit enableSftpExplorer flag should show the SFTP explorer action.

embeddedLogger.defaultEnableWebBrowser.description: Whether devices without an explicit enableWebBrowser flag should show the external web browser action.

embeddedLogger.defaultEnableEmbeddedWebB.description: Whether devices without an explicit enableEmbeddedWebBrowser flag should show the embedded web browser action.

embeddedLogger.defaultSshCommands.description: Reusable SSH commands that can be shown before each device's own SSH commands in the Devices view.
embeddedLogger.defaultSshCommands.markdownDescription:
Reusable SSH commands that can be shown before each device's own SSH commands in the Devices view.

Each device can disable them with `showDefaultSshCommands: false` to show only its device-specific commands.

When `copyAndRunScript` is enabled, the optional `script` is copied to `/tmp`, made executable with `chmod 777`, and run after the optional `command`.

Example:
```json
[
  {
    "name": "🔁 Reboot",
    "command": "reboot",
    "openSshPanel": false,
    "rerunOnReconnection": false
  },
  {
    "name": "⚙️ Restart Service",
    "command": "systemctl restart my-service",
    "openSshPanel": false,
    "rerunOnReconnection": false
  },
  {
    "name": "📈 Processes",
    "command": "top",
    "openSshPanel": true,
    "rerunOnReconnection": true
  },
  {
    "name": "🚀 Deploy helper",
    "command": "echo Preparing deployment",
    "copyAndRunScript": true,
    "script": "#!/bin/sh\nprintf \"Deploying on %s\\n\" \"$(hostname)\"\n"
  }
]
```

name.description: Display name for the SSH command.

command.description: Optional command to execute before the uploaded script runs.

openSshPanel.description: Whether to open the command in an SSH terminal panel and keep the session open.

rerunOnReconnection.description: Whether an SSH-panel command should be re-run automatically after the panel reconnects.

copyAndRunScript.description: Whether to copy the configured script to /tmp over SFTP, set chmod 777, and run it after the optional command.

script.description: Optional script content to copy to /tmp and run when copyAndRunScript is enabled.

embeddedLogger.groups.description: Optional ordered list of device groups displayed in the Embedded Devices view.

name.description: Group name shown in the devices view.

embeddedLogger.devices.description: List of embedded devices to stream logs from.
embeddedLogger.devices.markdownDescription:
List of embedded devices to stream logs from.

Manage devices with the **Embedded Logger: Edit Devices Configuration** Device Manager (table UI with add/remove rows and all fields). You can also choose **Edit in settings.json** for direct JSON editing.

When `copyAndRunScript` is enabled for an SSH command, the optional `script` is copied to `/tmp`, made executable with `chmod 777`, and run after the optional `command`.

Example:
```json
[
  {
    "id": "rpi4",
    "group": "Lab",
    "color": "#4fc3f7",
    "name": "Raspberry Pi 4",
    "host": "192.168.1.50",
    "hostFingerprint": "SHA256:your-base64-fingerprint",
    "secondaryHost": "192.168.1.51",
    "secondaryHostFingerprint": "SHA256:secondary-base64-fingerprint",
    "port": 22,
    "username": "pi",
    "password": "",
    "privateKeyPath": "/home/user/.ssh/id_ed25519",
    "privateKeyPassphrase": "${env:KEY_PASSPHRASE}",
    "logCommand": "journalctl -f -u app.service",
    "enableSshTerminal": true,
    "enableSftpExplorer": true,
    "enableWebBrowser": false,
    "enableEmbeddedWebBrowser": false,
    "webBrowserUrl": "http://192.168.1.50",
    "showDefaultSshCommands": true,
    "sshCommands": [
      {
        "name": "🔁 Reboot",
        "command": "reboot",
        "openSshPanel": false,
        "rerunOnReconnection": false
      },
      {
        "name": "⚙️ Restart Service",
        "command": "systemctl restart my-service",
        "openSshPanel": false,
        "rerunOnReconnection": false
      },
      {
        "name": "📈 Processes",
        "command": "top",
        "openSshPanel": true,
        "rerunOnReconnection": true
      },
      {
        "name": "🚀 Deploy helper",
        "command": "echo Preparing deployment",
        "copyAndRunScript": true,
        "script": "#!/bin/sh\nprintf \"Deploying on %s\\n\" \"$(hostname)\"\n"
      }
    ],
    "bastion": {
      "host": "bastion.example.com",
      "hostFingerprint": "SHA256:bastion-fingerprint",
      "port": 22,
      "username": "jump-user",
      "password": "",
      "privateKeyPath": "${env:HOME}/.ssh/id_ed25519",
      "privateKeyPassphrase": ""
    }
  }
]
```

group.description: Optional group name used to nest this device under a collapsible group in the Embedded Devices view.

color.description: Optional color for the device indicator and related tabs (defaults to the editor tab title color).

name.description: Friendly name shown in the sidebar.

hostFingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the device's SSH host key (for example, output of ssh-keygen -lf -E sha256).

secondaryHost.description: Optional fallback hostname or IP address to try when the primary host is unavailable.

secondaryHostFingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the fallback host's SSH key.

bastion.description: Optional bastion/jump host to reach the device through.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the bastion host.

hostFingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the bastion host's SSH key.

port.description: SSH port for the bastion host.

username.description: SSH username for the bastion host.

password.description: Password field for the bastion; stored to secret storage on first use.

privateKeyPath.description: Path to an SSH private key for the bastion host.

privateKeyPassphrase.description: Passphrase field for bastion keys; stored to secret storage on first use.

password.description: Password field; stored to secret storage on first use.

privateKeyPath.description: Path to an SSH private key to authenticate with instead of a password.
privateKeyPath.markdownDescription:
Path to an SSH private key to authenticate with instead of a password.

Examples:
- `/home/user/.ssh/id_ed25519`
- `${env:HOME}/.ssh/id_rsa`

privateKeyPassphrase.description: Passphrase field for encrypted keys; stored to secret storage on first use.

logCommand.description: Command to stream logs (defaults to tail -F /var/log/syslog).

enableSshTerminal.description: Whether to show an Open SSH Terminal action for this device.

enableSftpExplorer.description: Whether to show an Open SFTP Explorer action for this device.

enableWebBrowser.description: Whether to show an Open External Web Browser action for this device.

enableEmbeddedWebBrowser.description: Whether to show an Open Embedded Web Browser action for this device.

webBrowserUrl.description: Optional URL to open for the device; defaults to http://<host> when omitted.

showDefaultSshCommands.description: Whether to prepend embeddedLogger.defaultSshCommands before this device's own sshCommands in the Devices view.

sftpPresetsRemote.description: Saved remote-path presets for the device's SFTP explorer.

sftpPresetsLocal.description: Saved local-path presets for the device's SFTP explorer.

sshCommands.description: Optional list of on-demand SSH commands available from the Devices view.

name.description: Display name for the SSH command.

command.description: Optional command to execute before the uploaded script runs.

openSshPanel.description: Whether to open the command in an SSH terminal panel and keep the session open.

rerunOnReconnection.description: Whether an SSH-panel command should be re-run automatically after the panel reconnects.

copyAndRunScript.description: Whether to copy the configured script to /tmp over SFTP, set chmod 777, and run it after the optional command.

script.description: Optional script content to copy to /tmp and run when copyAndRunScript is enabled.

embeddedLogger.maxLinesPerTab.description: Maximum number of log lines retained per log tab before older lines are discarded.

embeddedLogger.enableDevicePing.description: Enable ping checks for configured devices and show ping indicators in the Devices view.

embeddedLogger.devicePingIntervalSeconds.description: Optional ping interval in seconds. Leave empty to ping only when the Ping button is pressed.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run test:coverage && npm run coverage:report && npm run test:e2e
